item.title: Advice to Young People, the Lies I Tell Myself (2024)
item.description:
📝 The reason is that the unlucky people were so focused on counting the photographs that they missed the giant text that said, "Stop counting, there are 43 photographs in this newspaper. " What I took away from this experiment was the idea that it might not be the case that lucky people and unlucky people have different opportunities, but rather that their field of perception is wider. Hey, I noticed that you read this book on your website.
🔗 Read more: https://jxnl.co/writing/2024/06/01/advice-to-young-people/

item.title: Show HN: M. C. Escher spiral in WebGL inspired by 3Blue1Brown
item.description:
📝 This leads to the visual impression that there are no separate instances of a repeated image but just a single image spiraling inwards. Computationally, to turn any classic image into a droste image a smaller version of the classic image has just to be renderered somewhere ontop of the original image. The next trick is to transform (rotate and scale) the image in its polar coordinate space.
🔗 Read more: https://static.laszlokorte.de/escher/
